test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-II (Held On: 08 Jan, 2024)
subject: general
question:
Identify the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the given sentence and select the option that rectifies the spelling error.

It is difficult to describe the pandemonium kicked up by various animals when they spot or suspectt a panther around.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, the word 'suspectt' is incorrect.
 
• The correct spelling of the word is **'suspect'**.
 
• Therefore, the correct word should be 'suspect' instead of 'suspectt'.

Hence, the correct statement is '*I**t is difficult to describe the pandemonium kicked up by various animals when they spot or suspect__ a panther around*****.'**
